a: A log scale's small-count ticks fall back to linear ticks when `every` thins the powers, giving no ticks or ticks crammed at one end
`ContinuousScaleFactory`'s doc names `powScale`, which is not one
A linear scale over a single non-integer value has no ticks (and so does a degenerate log domain off the 1/2/5 values)
A band scale with one category, paddingInner 1 and paddingOuter 0 reports a step 1e9 times its range
b: warpTicks returns no ticks, or one, for a narrow domain away from zero: the offset decade has no 7s or 9s
tickDecimals counts places to an absolute 1e-9, so a given column of small ticks all label "0"
Weekly time ticks fall on Thursdays
